div.div:
Type-3 · Inclusive multicast
"I am a VTEP for VNI 10010"
Builds the flood list: who gets a copy of a broadcast or unknown frame (ingress replication)
Seen in: scenario 1, three copies of one ARP

div.div:
Type-2 · MAC/IP advertisement
"50:01:00:08:00:00 / 10.10.10.108 is behind VTEP 10.0.0.5"
Bridging without flooding, ARP suppression, /32 host routes, host moves
Seen in: scenarios 1, 2 and 3

Type-5 · IP prefix
"10.30.30.0/24 is behind VTEP 10.0.1.10"
Reaches a subnet before any host in it has been learned
Seen in: scenario 2, the cold destination
